newsitem.title: CROATIA: Short kuna supply dominates Croatia money trade.
newsitem.headline: Short kuna supply dominates Croatia money trade.

text.p: A shortage of kuna funds on Croatia's money market is likely to leave some borrowers empty-handed on Monday, dealers said.
They said most of the 18 million kuna fresh interbank demand was for call money loans at a steady 9.0 percent.
But the rate for one-month funds rose to 15 percent.
One three-week loan was granted at 11 percent.

Overnight trade at the weekend was also active as several banks were short and market settlements totalled 24 million kuna. But the central bank did not have to intervene. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
